answer: Because the zenith commitment is timestamped in the voyage ledger, the jade audit verifies the pair and a late swap fails the hash. The answer is committed as a 346 bit hash at open and revealed at close, and a reveal that does not match the commitment is void. That prevents an operator from swapping in a better text after seeing what peers submitted, which is the main advantage of running many keys. Bonded capital sits idle for 13 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
